title: The good old days? Mental health across birth cohorts
title_zh: 美好的旧时光？不同出生队列的心理健康
title_primary: 美好的旧时光？不同出生队列的心理健康
title_secondary: The good old days? Mental health across birth cohorts
authors: Lenzen, Sabrina, Connelly, Luke B., Whittaker, William
official: 官方在线 2026-09-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The share of young Australians reporting poor mental health has risen sharply over the past two decades, a pattern mirrored across many high-income countries. A central question is whether this reflects a genuine deterioration in underlying mental health or shifts in how different birth cohorts report their symptoms. Using 22 years of nationally representative longitudinal survey data from Australia (2002–2023), we construct a predicted mental health index from respondents’ socioeconomic characteristics, childhood conditions, physical health, life events, and financial circumstances, and compare it against self-reported mental health to isolate cohort-specific reporting differences. We find that the answer is both, namely, that younger cohorts apply lower thresholds when reporting distress, reflecting greater willingness to acknowledge poor mental health, and underlying mental health has genuinely deteriorated among recent cohorts, particularly females. Adjusting for cohort-specific reporting thresholds flattens the apparent rise in poor mental health, though a deterioration remains. After adjustment, the age gradient steepens, revealing that poor mental health peaks in mid-life, a life-cycle pattern that is obscured in raw self-reports. Our findings underscore the importance of accounting for reporting heterogeneity when interpreting mental health trends and planning health services.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，澳大利亚年轻人中报告心理健康状况不佳的比例急剧上升，这一现象在许多高收入国家同样存在。核心问题在于，这是否反映了潜在心理健康的真实恶化，抑或是不同出生队列在报告其症状方式上的差异。利用澳大利亚2002年至2023年间22年的全国代表性纵向调查数据，我们根据受访者的社会经济特征、童年条件、身体健康、生活事件及财务状况构建了一个预测心理健康指数，并将其与自我报告的心理健康状况进行比较，以分离出特定队列的报告差异。我们发现答案两者兼有，即较年轻的队列在报告心理困扰时采用了较低阈值，反映出他们更愿意承认心理健康不佳，同时近期队列（尤其是女性）的潜在心理健康确实出现了恶化。调整队列特定报告阈值后，心理健康不佳的表观上升趋势有所平缓，但恶化现象依然存在。调整后，年龄梯度变得更加陡峭，揭示出心理健康不佳在中年达到顶峰，这一生命周期模式在原始自我报告中并不明显。我们的研究结果强调了在解读心理健康趋势及规划卫生服务时，考虑报告异质性的重要性。

title: Rethinking the Credit-Growth Nexus: New Credit Flows and Private Demand in the Euro Area
title_zh: 重新审视信贷与增长的关系：欧元区新增信贷流动与私人需求
title_primary: 重新审视信贷与增长的关系：欧元区新增信贷流动与私人需求
title_secondary: Rethinking the Credit-Growth Nexus: New Credit Flows and Private Demand in the Euro Area
authors: Jiri Podpiera
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes the credit-growth nexus by shifting the focus from aggregate leverage and credit stocks to new credit flows. Using quarterly data for 12 euro area countries over 2007–24, covering 96 percent of euro area GDP, the analysis shows a robust empirical association between newly granted bank credit and private final domestic demand (PFDD), a close proxy for GDP. A 10 percent increase in new private credit is associated with about 0.5–0.7 percentage points growth in PFDD. In contrast, specifications based on credit stocks or leverage produce unstable or counterintuitive estimates, reflecting measurement biases related to debt repayments and denominator effects. Nothwithstanding the importance of debt levels and leverage for financial stability and through debt service for the economy, the findings suggest that new credit flows appear to provide a more empirically reliable proxy for the macroeconomic role of bank lending.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将研究焦点从总体杠杆率和信贷存量转向新增信贷流量，分析了信贷与增长之间的关系。利用2007年至2024年间12个欧元区国家的季度数据，覆盖欧元区GDP的96%，分析显示新增银行信贷与私人最终国内需求（PFDD）之间存在稳健的经验关联，后者是GDP的紧密近似指标。新增私人信贷每增加10%，与PFDD增长约0.5至0.7个百分点相关。相比之下，基于信贷存量或杠杆率的规格估计结果不稳定或违背直觉，这反映了与债务偿还和分母效应相关的测量偏差。尽管债务水平和杠杆率对金融稳定以及通过债务服务对经济具有重要意义，但研究结果表明，新增信贷流量似乎为银行信贷的宏观经济作用提供了更具经验可靠性的代理指标。

title: Do you remember? Prosocial behavior declines in memory-based decisions
title_zh: 你记得吗？基于记忆的决策中亲社会行为会减少
title_primary: 你记得吗？基于记忆的决策中亲社会行为会减少
title_secondary: Do you remember? Prosocial behavior declines in memory-based decisions
authors: Sebastian Olschewski
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Many economic decisions affect other stakeholders, yet information about these consequences is often not directly available at the moment of choice and must instead be recalled from memory. Here, three studies examine how memory processes shape social behavior and whether their behavioral effects are better explained by motivated memory or rational accounts of memory allocation. In Study 1, participants made binary dictator-game decisions in which the consequences for themselves and another player were represented by pictures whose monetary outcomes had to be learned and later recalled from memory. Compared with the control condition in which all outcome information was available on the decision screen, participants chose less prosocially when decisions relied on memory. Studies 2 and 3 showed that prosocial choice in memory-based dictator games did not reliably increase either when strategic encoding of outcomes was made impossible or when accurate recall was monetarily incentivized. A structural model with a social utility function indicates that memory-based decisions reduce the weight placed on the other player’s outcome in unequal allocations that are advantageous to the dictator. Across choices, recall patterns, structural modeling, and individual differences, the results are most consistent with motivated forgetting during decision making: participants appear to selectively fail to retrieve information about social consequences when this information would make selfish choices harder to justify. These findings suggest that making consequences for other stakeholders salient at the moment of choice can promote socially beneficial behavior.
abstract_zh: 许多经济决策会影响到其他利益相关者，然而在决策时刻，关于这些后果的信息往往无法直接获取，必须依赖记忆进行回忆。本研究通过三项实验探讨记忆过程如何塑造社会行为，并检验其行为效应是否更符合动机性记忆或理性记忆分配的解释。在研究1中，参与者进行二元独裁者博弈决策，其中对自身及另一玩家的后果以图片形式呈现，图片所对应的货币结果需先学习后回忆。与决策屏幕上所有结果信息均可见的控制条件相比，当决策依赖记忆时，参与者的亲社会选择减少。研究2和研究3表明，在基于记忆的独裁者博弈中，无论是使结果策略性编码变得不可能，还是对准确回忆给予金钱激励，亲社会选择均未可靠增加。一个包含社会效用函数的结构模型显示，基于记忆的决策降低了对独裁者有利的不平等分配中另一玩家结果的权重。综合选择行为、回忆模式、结构建模及个体差异的分析，结果最符合决策过程中的动机性遗忘：当关于社会后果的信息会使自私选择更难合理化时，参与者似乎选择性地未能检索这些信息。这些发现表明，在决策时刻凸显对其他利益相关者的后果，可以促进有益于社会的行为。

title: Cultural Evolution
title_zh: 文化演化
title_primary: 文化演化
title_secondary: Cultural Evolution
authors: Oded Galor, Marc Klemp, Daniel C. Wainstock
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What gave rise to the mosaic of cultural expressions across the globe? Why are some societies more culturally diverse than others? This study develops a unified theory of cultural evolution, characterizing the forces that have governed this process over the course of human existence. The research advances the hypothesis that population movements and socioeconomic transformations generated a mismatch between inherited cultural traits and prevailing ecological and societal conditions, setting in motion an evolutionary process governed by adaptation-based vertical transmission, horizontal diffusion, and fitness-based evolutionary selection. The theory generates novel testable predictions concerning the origins of the global cultural mosaic and the cross-societal variation in cultural diversity. First, greater ecological distance between ancestral environments generated greater cultural distance across societies. Second, prehistoric differences in ancestral diversity contributed to divergent adaptive capacity and greater cultural distance. Third, societies descended from more diverse prehistoric populations exhibit greater cultural diversity despite convergence induced by adaptation to a common environment and societal norms. Drawing on measures of cultural distance and diversity derived from folkloric and musical traditions among ethnic groups, visual representations of common concepts, and the dispersion of norms, values, and attitudes, the empirical analysis lends credence to the predictions of the theory.
abstract_zh: 是什么造就了全球文化表现形式的马赛克式多样性？为何某些社会的文化多样性程度高于其他社会？本研究构建了一个统一的文化演化理论，刻画了在人类历史进程中主导这一过程的种种力量。研究提出假设，认为人口迁移与社会经济转型导致了遗传下来的文化特质与当时生态及社会条件之间的错配，从而启动了一个由基于适应的垂直传递、水平扩散及基于适应性的进化选择所支配的演化过程。该理论就全球文化马赛克的起源及跨社会文化多样性差异提出了新颖的可检验预测。首先，祖先环境间更大的生态距离导致了跨社会间更大的文化距离。其次，史前祖先多样性的差异促成了不同的适应能力及更大的文化距离。第三，尽管因适应共同环境和社会规范而出现趋同，源自更大多样性史前人口的社会仍展现出更大的文化多样性。基于从族群间的民俗与音乐传统、共同概念的视觉表征以及规范、价值观和态度的分布中提取的文化距离与多样性度量，实证分析为理论的预测提供了支持。

title: Voter preferences over interval platforms: Axioms, canonical reduction, and valence-minus-penalty representation
title_zh: 区间平台上的选民偏好：公理、规范约简与价值减惩罚表示
title_primary: 区间平台上的选民偏好：公理、规范约简与价值减惩罚表示
title_secondary: Voter preferences over interval platforms: Axioms, canonical reduction, and valence-minus-penalty representation
authors: Daeseok Kim
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop an axiomatic framework for evaluating interval policy platforms. Rather than treating an interval platform as a noisy point estimate, we interpret it as a commitment set and study how voters rank such sets under geometric invariances, valence monotonicity, and continuity. Our first result is an ordinal dimensional reduction: at any fixed valence level, preferences over interval platforms are order-equivalent to preferences over a single scalar index that aggregates distance and width (the Canonical Reduction (CR) index). We then add valence-shift invariance and obtain a valence-minus-penalty representation: voters behave as if utility increases with valence and decreases with a monotone transform of the CR-index. This representation yields empirically refutable restrictions on distance–width trade-offs while remaining agnostic about probabilistic microfoundations. To illustrate, we embed it in a Downsian environment with reduced-form precision costs and show how, in a symmetric benchmark, electoral competition separates into location and width choices. The framework therefore provides a tractable benchmark for analyzing strategic imprecision in electoral competition and related social-science settings.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个公理化框架，用以评估区间政策平台。不同于将区间平台视为带噪声的点估计，我们将其解释为承诺集合，并研究选民在几何不变性、效价单调性和连续性条件下如何对这些集合进行排序。我们的首个结果是序数维度缩减：在任一固定效价水平下，对区间平台的偏好与对单一标量指数的偏好序等价，该指数综合了距离与宽度（即规范缩减（CR）指数）。随后，我们引入效价平移不变性，得到效价减去惩罚的表示形式：选民的行为表现为效用随效价增加而增加，并随CR指数的单调变换而减少。该表示形式对距离-宽度权衡施加了可经验反驳的约束，同时保持对概率微观基础的中立态度。为加以说明，我们将其嵌入一个具有简化形式精度成本的唐斯式环境中，并展示在对称基准情形下，选举竞争如何分解为位置与宽度的选择。因此，该框架为分析选举竞争及相关社会科学情境中的策略性模糊性提供了一个易于处理的基准。

title: Rational Expectations and Market Timing: An Event Study of the China–United States Phase One Trade Deal
title_zh: 理性预期与市场择时：中美第一阶段贸易协议的事件研究
title_primary: 理性预期与市场择时：中美第一阶段贸易协议的事件研究
title_secondary: Rational Expectations and Market Timing: An Event Study of the China–United States Phase One Trade Deal
authors: Tim Ölkers, Oliver Mußhoff
official: 官方在线 2026-08-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Rational actors constantly incorporate information into their decision‐making behavior. Since there is often a time lag between the announcement of a policy and its implementation, an important question arises: when do rational actors incorporate new information into their market behavior, at the announcement or at the implementation of a policy? We investigate this question using the easing of trade tensions between China and the United States, marked by the “Phase One” trade deal announced in December 2019 and signed in January 2020, as a considerable positive trade shock. Focusing on two key events, the announcement of substantial tariff reductions on December 13, 2019, and the signing of the trade deal in January 2020, this study examines how both the announcement and the implementation of reduced trade barriers affected agricultural companies' stock prices. We employ an event study approach using data from the MSCI ACWI Select Agriculture Producers Investable Market Index to assess market reactions. The findings are consistent with the hypothesis derived from the conceptual framework, showing that rational market actors incorporate information at the announcement stage, not only at the implementation of a policy. However, sub‐industry analyses indicate that a subset of sub‐industries drives the aggregate effect, while additional heterogeneity analysis shows that the magnitude of the effects differs across continents. These findings are relevant for policymakers, businesses, and economists seeking to understand the broader economic implications of international trade agreements in general, and trade disputes in particular.
abstract_zh: 理性行为者不断将信息纳入其决策行为之中。由于政策从宣布到实施往往存在时间差，一个关键问题随之产生：理性行为者是在政策宣布时还是实施时，将新信息融入其市场行为？本文以2019年12月宣布、2020年1月签署的“第一阶段”贸易协议为标志的中美贸易紧张局势缓和作为一次显著的正向贸易冲击，对此问题进行探究。研究聚焦于两个关键事件——2019年12月13日宣布大幅削减关税及2020年1月贸易协议的签署，考察贸易壁垒降低的宣布与实施如何影响农业企业的股价。我们采用事件研究法，利用MSCI ACWI精选农业生产者投资市场指数的数据评估市场反应。研究结果与概念框架推导出的假设一致，表明理性市场行为者在政策宣布阶段即纳入信息，而非仅在政策实施时。然而，子行业分析显示，总体效应由部分子行业驱动，而进一步的异质性分析表明，效应大小在不同大洲间存在差异。这些发现对政策制定者、企业及经济学家理解国际贸易协定（尤其是贸易争端）的更广泛经济影响具有参考价值。

title: Optimal Inflation Rate: A Meta-Analysis
title_zh: 最优通货膨胀率：一项元分析
title_primary: 最优通货膨胀率：一项元分析
title_secondary: Optimal Inflation Rate: A Meta-Analysis
authors: Matej Opatrny, Martin Opatrny, Tomas Havranek, Zuzana Irsova, Mojmir Hampl
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We revisit the optimal long-run inflation rate using 777 estimates from 116 primary studies published between 1989 and 2026, the largest sample assembled to date. To our knowledge, this is among the first meta-analyses in economics whose primary-data extraction is performed end-to-end through a documented and auditable large-language-model pipeline, calibrated against a hand-coded training set and released for replication. Across publication-selection and selection-on-significance diagnostics that are applicable in this calibration-dominated corpus, the literature points to an optimum of roughly 0.6 percentage points per year, well below the two-percent targets commonly used by advanced-economy central banks. Bayesian model averaging over the full structural-moderator schema shows that cross-study variation is driven by genuine modelling choices, the choice of monetary benchmark (Friedman rule vs. laissez-faire), the transactions-frictions technology, the assumed shock structure, and the class of nominal-rigidity contract, rather than by selective reporting.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了最优长期通胀率，基于1989年至2026年间发表的116项主要研究中的777项估计值，这是迄今为止汇集的最大样本。据我们所知，这是经济学中首批通过文档化且可审计的大型语言模型流程端到端进行原始数据提取的元分析之一，该流程依据手工编码的训练集进行校准，并公开以供复制。在适用于这一以校准为主导的文献库的出版选择和显著性选择诊断中，文献指向每年约0.6个百分点的最优值，远低于发达经济体央行常用的2%目标。对完整结构调节变量模式的贝叶斯模型平均显示，跨研究差异源于真实的建模选择、货币基准的选择（弗里德曼规则与自由放任）、交易摩擦技术、假设的冲击结构以及名义刚性合同的类别，而非选择性报告所致。

title: Communities of Commerce: The Legacy of Chinese Immigration on Java
title_zh: 商业社群：华人移民爪哇的遗产
title_primary: 商业社群：华人移民爪哇的遗产
title_secondary: Communities of Commerce: The Legacy of Chinese Immigration on Java
authors: Quoc-Anh Do, Sebastian Ellingsen, Gedeon Lim
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the long-run impacts of diasporas on local economic development. We do so in the context of one of the most economically influential diasporas: the ethnic Chinese in Southeast Asia. Our instrumental variables strategy exploits 15th-century landing sites on Java that shaped subsequent Chinese settlement but lost maritime access due to 17th-century silting. We find that a 1p.p. higher Chinese share in 1930 leads to 9.4% higher household consumption and 26% higher population today. These effects attenuate sharply during the 1997-1998 crisis, then recover. We find strong effects on firm sales driven by improved financing through local private networks but not through exports. We provide suggestive evidence for the key role of historical ethnic-trading networks within Java. Our findings suggest that despite their small size, ethnic minorities with durable complementarities can play an out-sized, positive role in local economic development.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了海外移民对地方经济发展的长期影响。我们以东南亚的华裔族群为背景，这是最具经济影响力的移民群体之一。我们的工具变量策略利用了15世纪爪哇岛的登陆点，这些登陆点塑造了后续华人定居格局，但因17世纪泥沙淤积而失去了海上通道。我们发现，1930年华裔比例每提高1个百分点，当今家庭消费增加9.4%，人口增加26%。这些影响在1997-1998年危机期间急剧减弱，随后恢复。我们发现，通过本地私人网络改善融资对企业销售有显著影响，但出口渠道并无此效应。我们提供了暗示性证据，表明爪哇岛内历史族裔贸易网络的关键作用。我们的研究结果表明，尽管少数族裔规模较小，但具有持久互补性的族裔群体能在地方经济发展中发挥超乎比例的积极作用。

title: The effects of the secondary market for corporate loans on the real economy
title_zh: 公司贷款二级市场对实体经济的影响
title_primary: 公司贷款二级市场对实体经济的影响
title_secondary: The effects of the secondary market for corporate loans on the real economy
authors: Miroslav Gabrovski, Ioannis Kospentaris, Lucie Lebeau
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: An increasing share of corporate loans, a critical source of firm credit, is sold off banks’ balance sheets and actively traded in a secondary over-the-counter market. We develop a microfounded equilibrium search-theoretic model with labor, credit, and financial markets to study the impact of this secondary loan market on the real economy. Our analysis highlights a policy-relevant trade-off: the market reduces the steady state level of unemployment by 0.21pp, but it also amplifies unemployment’s response to a 1% productivity drop by 0.07pp. Trading delays in the secondary market matter significantly: if trade were instantaneous, steady state unemployment and its volatility would decline by 1.49pp and by 0.24pp, respectively.
abstract_zh: 企业贷款作为企业信贷的关键来源，其日益增长的份额正从银行资产负债表中剥离，并在二级场外市场中活跃交易。我们构建了一个包含劳动力市场、信贷市场和金融市场的微观基础均衡搜索理论模型，以研究这一二级贷款市场对实体经济的影响。我们的分析揭示了一个具有政策相关性的权衡：该市场将稳态失业率降低了0.21个百分点，但同时将失业率对1%生产率下降的响应放大了0.07个百分点。二级市场中的交易延迟影响显著：若交易即时完成，稳态失业率及其波动性将分别下降1.49个百分点和0.24个百分点。

title: Modelling income risk dynamics in the UK: a parametric approach
title_zh: 英国收入风险动态建模：参数化方法
title_primary: 英国收入风险动态建模：参数化方法
title_secondary: Modelling income risk dynamics in the UK: a parametric approach
authors: Marco D’Amico & Martina Fazio
official: 官方在线 2025-05-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper uses rich, administrative-quality data on earnings in the UK from the Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE) to provide a detailed analysis of income risk and its patterns across individuals and over time. We develop a model of income dynamics that accounts for the broader state of the economy and successfully captures key features of the UK earnings growth distribution, including: a cyclical variance, procyclical skewness (more frequent negative earnings shocks during recessions), and a distribution that combines sharp peaks with long, heavy tails. The model is simple enough to be integrated into broader macroeconomic frameworks, such as heterogeneous agent models, and could be used to support policy scenario analysis.
abstract_zh: 本文利用英国《工时与收入年度调查》（ASHE）中具有行政质量的高精度收入数据，对收入风险及其在个体间与时间维度上的分布模式进行了详细分析。我们构建了一个考虑宏观经济整体状态的收入动态模型，该模型成功捕捉了英国收入增长分布的关键特征，包括：周期性方差、顺周期偏度（经济衰退期间负向收入冲击更为频繁），以及兼具尖峰与长厚尾特征的分布形态。该模型结构简洁，可整合至更广泛的宏观经济框架（如异质性主体模型）中，并可用于支持政策情景分析。

title: Capital reallocation under climate policy uncertainty
title_zh: 气候政策不确定性下的资本再配置

authors: Makram Khalil, Felix Strobel

abstract: Climate policy uncertainty (CPU) shocks can induce capital reallocation from carbon-intensive sectors to low-emitting sectors. We first show, using a DSGE model with financial frictions and various climate policy tools, that CPU shocks (i) lower the market value of the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector and (ii) reduce real investment in the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector. The financial channel plays a key role for this reallocation. Second, we document that these results align with firm-level evidence from the US. We find that empirical CPU shocks (i) cause financial markets to revalue firms in carbon-intensive sectors relative to firms in low-emitting sectors, and (ii) lead to substantial investment reallocation, particularly from manufacturing towards services. abstract: The current debate in Western Europe centers on the relationship between economic and political integration. To address this problem, we construct a simple general equilibrium model in which the returns to trading are directly affected by the availability of a public good. In our model, heterogeneous agents choose both a club and a market to belong to. In the club, agents vote over the public good, are taxed to finance this good, and receive access to it when they trade. In the market, they are randomly matched with a partner. If a match occurs between traders of different clubs, they both suffer a transactions cost.
abstract_zh: 当前西欧的辩论焦点在于经济一体化与政治一体化之间的关系。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个简单的一般均衡模型，其中贸易收益直接受到公共品可得性的影响。在该模型中，异质性主体需同时选择加入某个俱乐部和某个市场。在俱乐部内部，成员通过投票决定公共品供给，缴纳相应税收以资助该公共品，并在贸易时获得其使用权；而在市场中，主体则随机匹配交易伙伴。若交易双方来自不同俱乐部，则需承担交易成本。

abstract: Exponential regressions are frequently used when outcomes are non-negative. They are attractive because they are easy to interpret and to estimate, using pseudomaximum likelihood (PML). However, the validity of these methods depends on the correct specification of the conditional expectation, and little is known regarding their properties when the conditional expectation is misspecified. We show that PML estimators of misspecified exponential models provide optimal approximations to the conditional expectation, in a weighted mean squared error sense, and we give conditions under which their Poisson PML estimator identifies average marginal effects.
abstract_zh: 当结果变量为非负值时，指数回归模型被广泛使用。这类模型因易于解释且可通过伪最大似然估计（PML）进行估计而备受青睐。然而，这些方法的有效性取决于条件期望的正确设定，而关于条件期望设定错误时模型性质的研究尚不充分。本文证明，在加权均方误差意义下，设定错误的指数模型的PML估计量能够为条件期望提供最优近似，并给出了泊松PML估计量识别平均边际效应的条件。

abstract: This study provides pre-registered, experimental evidence on the use of non-generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots to support students in large-enrollment undergraduate courses. We find the chatbot messaging increased students’ final grades and engagement with academic supports, such as tutoring. Treatment effects were generally consistent across student demographics, with the exception of treated women in a Microeconomics course, who earned final grades that were seven percentage points higher than women in the control group. This study provides evidence that integrating AI-enabled outreach and communication to students in their college courses can enhance student engagement, learning, and course performance.
abstract_zh: 本研究提供了关于在大型本科课程中使用非生成式人工智能（AI）聊天机器人辅助学生的预注册实验证据。我们发现，聊天机器人信息提高了学生的期末成绩以及参与学术支持（如辅导）的积极性。处理效应在不同学生群体中总体一致，但微观经济学课程中接受干预的女性除外，其期末成绩比对照组女性高出七个百分点。本研究证明，将人工智能驱动的外联与沟通融入大学课程中，能够增强学生的参与度、学习效果及课程表现。

title_zh: 碎片化世界中的国际风险分担

authors: Javier Bianchi, Sebastian Horn, Giovanni Rosso, César Sosa-Padilla
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how geopolitical risk shapes financial fragmentation and international risk-sharing, using bilateral official lending data from 1910 to 2024. We document that when geopolitical risk is high, bilateral lending increasingly follows geopolitical alignment. Because geopolitically aligned countries experience more synchronized shocks, this fragmentation limits the effectiveness of international risk-sharing. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce geopolitical considerations into a limited-commitment model of sovereign borrowing. The model shows that, even with non-discriminatory default, higher geopolitical tensions redirect international lending toward allied countries and weaken risk-sharing.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1910年至2024年的双边官方贷款数据，研究地缘政治风险如何塑造金融碎片化与国际风险分担。我们记录到，当地缘政治风险较高时，双边贷款日益遵循地缘政治联盟。由于地缘政治联盟国家面临更同步的冲击，这种碎片化限制了国际风险分担的有效性。为解释这些模式，我们将地缘政治因素引入有限承诺的主权借款模型。模型表明，即使存在非歧视性违约，更高的地缘政治紧张局势也会将国际贷款转向盟国，并削弱风险分担。

title_secondary: Fragmentation of shareholder power
authors: Andrey Malenko, Nadya Malenko
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The asset management industry is increasingly shifting toward tailored portfolios, fund proliferation, and decentralization of stewardship—trends partly driven by growing heterogeneity in investor preferences. While these developments better align investment products with investor demands, they also reshape ownership structures, potentially leading to more fragmented ownership and weaker managerial oversight. We develop a framework to evaluate these trade-offs and show that fund proliferation does not necessarily weaken governance: Stronger incentives for asset managers and concentrated portfolios of specialized funds can offset these effects, especially when investor preferences are intense. However, strong investor preferences can also induce asset managers to compete on a new margin—granting investors control by decentralizing stewardship and adopting pass-through voting—without internalizing the associated governance costs.
abstract_zh: 资产管理行业正日益转向定制化投资组合、基金数量激增以及管理权分散化——这些趋势部分源于投资者偏好的日益多样化。尽管这些发展使投资产品与投资者需求更加契合，但也重塑了所有权结构，可能导致所有权更加分散、管理层监督弱化。我们构建了一个评估这些权衡关系的分析框架，并发现基金数量激增并不必然削弱公司治理：资产管理人更强的激励机制以及专业基金集中化的投资组合能够抵消上述影响，尤其在投资者偏好强烈时更为显著。然而，强烈的投资者偏好也可能促使资产管理人在新维度展开竞争——通过分散管理权并采用传递投票机制将控制权让渡给投资者——却未将相应的治理成本内部化。

title: Task-Specific Technical Change and Comparative Advantage
title_zh: 任务特定型技术变革与比较优势

authors: Lukas Althoff, Hugo Reichardt
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes workers’ comparative advantage by altering the tasks they perform and the skills those tasks require. We develop a dynamic task-based model to quantify the general-equilibrium effects of task-specific technical change. Workers have multidimensional skills, choose occupations, and accumulate skills on the job; occupations combine tasks, and productivity depends on how workers’ skills match task requirements. We develop a computationally efficient procedure to estimate the model using panel data and a new database of task-level skill requirements. We apply the model to AI, allowing it to augment, automate, and simplify tasks. We find that AI narrows wage inequality and raises average wages across scenarios ranging from slow to rapid AI progress. The key equalizing force is simplification: by lowering tasks’ skill requirements, AI lets lower-skill workers compete for previously inaccessible jobs. Adoption costs, highest for lower-skill workers, dampen but do not eliminate the decline in inequality.
abstract_zh: 人工智能通过改变工人执行的任务及其所需技能，重塑了工人的比较优势。我们构建了一个动态任务模型，以量化任务特定技术变革的一般均衡效应。工人具备多维技能，选择职业并在工作中积累技能；职业由多项任务组合而成，生产率取决于工人技能与任务要求的匹配程度。我们开发了一种计算高效的方法，利用面板数据及全新的任务级技能要求数据库对模型进行估计。我们将该模型应用于人工智能领域，允许其增强、自动化及简化任务。研究发现，在从缓慢到快速的人工智能发展情景中，人工智能均能缩小工资不平等并提高平均工资。关键均衡力量在于简化：通过降低任务的技能要求，人工智能使低技能工人能够竞争此前无法胜任的岗位。采用成本（对低技能工人影响最大）虽会抑制但无法消除不平等程度的下降。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study women’s underrepresentation in science by experimentally examining gender imbalance in music composition and whether it is due to unfair judgment in evaluative settings. We invite composition faculty to rate new compositions associated with randomly assigned gendered names along with live recordings directed by the same conductor. We find no evidence of gender bias against women, and in fact compositions associated with female names are rated higher than those associated with male names. Further, reviewers do not favor compositions by composers of their own gender. We find suggestive evidence that male faculty and senior faculty favor female composers in both overall and structured evaluations. These findings should be interpreted with caution, as the study’s external validity is limited by the modest response rate and demographic composition of respondents.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究音乐创作中的性别失衡现象，探讨其是否源于评审环境中的不公正判断，以此考察科学领域中女性代表性不足的问题。我们邀请作曲系教师对随机分配性别化名字的新作品进行评分，并同时提供由同一指挥家指挥的现场录音。结果显示，我们没有发现针对女性的性别偏见证据，事实上，与男性名字关联的作品相比，女性名字关联的作品获得了更高的评分。此外，评审者并未偏好与自己性别相同的作曲家。我们发现有提示性证据表明，男性教师和资深教师在整体及结构化评价中均更倾向于女性作曲家。然而，这些发现应谨慎解读，因为研究的回应率及受访者人口构成有限，限制了其外部有效性。

title: Mergers and investments in new products
title_zh: 新产品并购与投资
title_primary: 新产品并购与投资
title_secondary: Mergers and investments in new products
authors: Anna D’Annunzio, Bruno Jullien, Yassine Lefouili, Leonardo Madio
official: 官方在线 2026-05-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how horizontal mergers affect firms’ incentives to invest in R&D leading to the development of new products. We characterize the impact of a merger to monopoly and a 3-to-2 merger on equilibrium innovation efforts and consumer surplus, absent efficiency gains and spillovers. We show that a 3-to-2 merger directly alters the outsider’s innovation incentives by shifting its best-response function upward, and we analyze how this mechanism affects merger outcomes for innovation and consumer surplus. Finally, we examine how efficiency gains and remedies modify post-merger innovation efforts.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了横向并购如何影响企业投资于研发以开发新产品的激励。我们刻画了并购至垄断及3对2并购对均衡创新努力和消费者剩余的影响，且不考虑效率增益和溢出效应。我们证明，3对2并购通过将外部企业的反应函数上移，直接改变了其创新激励，并分析了这一机制如何影响并购在创新和消费者剩余方面的结果。最后，我们探讨了效率增益和补救措施如何调整并购后的创新努力。

title: The emergence of the poverty-mental health gradient: Evidence from the great Pakistan earthquake of 2005
title_zh: 贫困-心理健康梯度的出现：来自2005年巴基斯坦大地震的证据
title_primary: 贫困-心理健康梯度的出现：来自2005年巴基斯坦大地震的证据
title_secondary: The emergence of the poverty-mental health gradient: Evidence from the great Pakistan earthquake of 2005
authors: Tahir Andrabi, Benjamin Daniels, Jishnu Das
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The poverty–mental health gradient varies substantially across populations, far more than sampling variation alone would predict. We treat this heterogeneity as a primary object of empirical interest. Using data collected four years after the 2005 Great Pakistan Earthquake from 126 villages spanning 0–75 km from the activated fault line, we show that in unaffected populations there is no correlation between consumption poverty and mental health. By contrast, among those nearest the fault, mental health improves by 0.12 standard deviations per log unit of consumption, while the relationship is a precise zero beyond 20 km. This gradient is robust to alternative distance thresholds, sample splits, and binary mental health measures, and is not mediated by acute household trauma. These results suggest that mass adversity can activate the poverty–mental health gradient, helping explain heterogeneity in the broader literature.
abstract_zh: 贫困与心理健康之间的梯度在不同人群中差异显著，远超单纯抽样变异所能解释的范围。我们将这种异质性视为实证研究的主要对象。利用2005年巴基斯坦大地震四年后从距活动断层0至75公里的126个村庄收集的数据，我们发现在未受影响的群体中，消费贫困与心理健康之间不存在相关性。相反，在距断层最近的群体中，每增加一个对数单位的消费，心理健康改善0.12个标准差，而在20公里以外，这一关系精确为零。该梯度对替代距离阈值、样本分割及二元心理健康指标均保持稳健，且不受急性家庭创伤的中介影响。这些结果表明，大规模逆境可能激活贫困与心理健康之间的梯度，有助于解释更广泛文献中的异质性现象。

title: From profit to planet: ESG’s impact on Chinese companies’ cross-border M&A activity*
title_zh: 从利润到地球：ESG对中国企业跨境并购活动的影响
title_primary: 从利润到地球：ESG对中国企业跨境并购活动的影响
title_secondary: From profit to planet: ESG’s impact on Chinese companies’ cross-border M&A activity*
authors: Bing Yan Meng Gao Qiugu He Wei Jin Siqiang Yang Renjia Zhang a Center for Transnational Studies, Institute of International Economics, School of Economics, Nankai University, Tianjin, P.R. Chinab China School of Banking and Finance 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper explores the influence of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) factors on Chinese companies’ cross-border mergers and acquisitions (M&A). It finds that acquirers prefer targets with equal or superior ESG ratings, reflecting a strategic emphasis on sustainability. While initial post-acquisition performance may face challenges, acquiring firms ultimately experience improvements in ESG performance, particularly through green innovation. This research highlights ESG’s growing importance in strategic decision-making, contributing to the literature on cross-border M&A and sustainability by offering insights into how ESG ratings shape acquisition outcomes and long-term corporate sustainability.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了环境、社会与治理（ESG）因素对中国企业跨境并购（M&A）的影响。研究发现，收购方倾向于选择ESG评级相当或更高的目标企业，这反映了对可持续性的战略重视。尽管并购初期业绩可能面临挑战，但收购企业最终在ESG表现上有所提升，尤其是通过绿色创新实现改善。本研究凸显了ESG在战略决策中日益增长的重要性，通过揭示ESG评级如何影响并购成果及企业长期可持续性，为跨境并购与可持续性领域的文献贡献了见解。

title: Digital transactions, COVID–19 and velocity of money: macroeconomic insights from an emerging market
title_zh: 数字交易、新冠疫情与货币流通速度：来自新兴市场的宏观经济洞察
title_primary: 数字交易、新冠疫情与货币流通速度：来自新兴市场的宏观经济洞察
title_secondary: Digital transactions, COVID–19 and velocity of money: macroeconomic insights from an emerging market
authors: Tugrul Gurgur Eyup Kahveci a Department of Economics, TOBB ETU University, Ankara, Turkeyb SBS Swiss Business School, Zurich, Switzerland
official: 官方在线 2025-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Digital monetary transactions are revolutionizing the way economies operate by enabling faster, more efficient, and cost-effective methods of value exchange. These developments carry significant macroeconomic implications, notably for the velocity of money (VoM). Despite the growing literature on digital payments and macroeconomic variables, the interaction between digital transactions, monetary aggregates, and structural shifts such as the COVID-19 pandemic remains underexplored, especially for developing economies. This study investigates the impact of digital transactions and the COVID-19 pandemic on VoM in Turkey while accounting for a comprehensive set of macroeconomic variables. Employing an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model with bounds-testing, we find a stable and positive long-run relationship: a 1% increase in digital payments raises VoM by 0.3%. The COVID-19 pandemic has amplified this effect, as lockdowns and social distancing measures have accelerated the adoption of contactless transactions. Among digital banking activities, digital payments emerge as the primary drivers of increased VoM, surpassing money transfers and online credit card use. Moreover, digital banking influences the circulation of currency more than broader monetary aggregates, mainly by displacing physical cash. These results confirm that rising VoM driven by digitalization may require more dynamic and forward-looking liquidity management and closer monitoring of payment systems.
abstract_zh: 数字货币交易正通过提供更快、更高效且成本更低的价值交换方式，彻底改变经济运作模式。这些发展具有显著的宏观经济影响，尤其是对货币流通速度（VoM）而言。尽管关于数字支付与宏观经济变量的文献日益增多，但数字交易、货币总量与诸如新冠疫情等结构性冲击之间的相互作用仍未得到充分探讨，尤其是在发展中经济体背景下。本研究考察了数字交易及新冠疫情对土耳其货币流通速度的影响，同时纳入了全面的宏观经济变量集。采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型并进行边界检验，我们发现存在稳定且正向的长期关系：数字支付每增加1%，货币流通速度将提升0.3%。新冠疫情放大了这一效应，因为封锁和社交距离措施加速了非接触式交易的普及。在数字银行活动中，数字支付成为提升货币流通速度的主要驱动力，其作用超过了转账和在线信用卡使用。此外，数字银行对通货流通的影响大于对更广泛货币总量的影响，这主要通过替代实物现金实现。这些结果证实，由数字化驱动的货币流通速度上升，可能需要更具动态性和前瞻性的流动性管理，以及对支付系统的更密切监测。

title: The political benefits of the monoculture: Estimating the electoral effect of the market facilitation program
title_zh: 单一栽培的政治收益：估算市场促进计划的选举效应
title_primary: 单一栽培的政治收益：估算市场促进计划的选举效应
title_secondary: The political benefits of the monoculture: Estimating the electoral effect of the market facilitation program
authors: Robert Gulotty, Anton Strezhnev
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2024-02-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Does the distribution of government transfers affect elections? We analyze a natural experiment in the 2019 wave of the US Department of Agriculture's Market Facilitation Program (MFP). The 2019 MFP allocated $14.5 billion via a formula combining historical production data and commodity-specific trade damages. We show how a methodological quirk resulted in arbitrary variation in these damages that propagated through the formula into excessive county-level compensation rates. We estimate the effects of this payment shock using a novel, design-based, randomization inference approach to account for complex dependencies across US counties. We find that counties receiving greater compensation rates, on average, have higher two-party Republican presidential vote shares in the 2020 election. Instrumenting for actual 2019 MFP disbursements, we find an additional $1 million in payments to a county increased that county's 2020 two-party Trump vote share by about .18 percentage points on average. Had the 2019 MFP maintained the spending levels of the 2018 wave, we estimate that Candidate Trump's two-party vote share would have been .117 percentage points lower nationally, with particularly pronounced effects in swing states like Arizona (.41 percentage points) and Georgia (.159 percentage points).
abstract_zh: 政府转移支付分配是否影响选举？我们以美国农业部2019年市场便利化计划（MFP）中的一项自然实验为分析对象。该计划通过结合历史生产数据与特定商品贸易损失的计算公式，拨款145亿美元。我们揭示了一个方法论缺陷如何导致这些贸易损失产生任意性波动，并通过公式传导至县级补偿率，形成过度差异。我们采用一种新颖的、基于设计的随机化推断方法，以处理美国各县之间的复杂依赖关系，从而估计这一支付冲击的影响。研究发现，平均而言，获得更高补偿率的县在2020年大选中两党制共和党总统得票率更高。以实际2019年MFP支付额为工具变量，我们发现，某县每额外获得100万美元支付，其2020年两党制特朗普得票率平均增加约0.18个百分点。若2019年MFP维持2018年的支出水平，我们估计候选人特朗普在全国范围内的两党制得票率将降低0.117个百分点，其中在亚利桑那州（0.41个百分点）和佐治亚州（0.159个百分点）等摇摆州的影响尤为显著。
